page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance belonging to the ecs.r7 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing a total of 128 vCPUs. This hardware configuration is paired with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. For network connectivity, the ecs.r7.32xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not feature any graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated physical cores combined with 1 TB of RAM makes this instance suitable for large-scale, memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. This profile is designed for workloads such as large in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and high-performance caching layers.
